table.title: Protestant Mission Statistics, 1919
table.caption_extra: Printed rotated (fold-out) across pp. 513-514; the second part, Y.M.C.A. and Y.W.C.A., continues on p. 514 below the mission table with its own column heads.
footnotes: 1 One worker included in London Mission report.
table.context: This fold-out appendix table sets out the 1919 statistics of the Protestant missions in Peking (foreign and native workers, places of worship, membership additions and attendance), followed by figures for the Y.M.C.A. and Y.W.C.A., within the Religious Work chapter.
transcriber_notes: Read from full-resolution crops of full/p0547.jpg (rotated 90 degrees) and full/p0548.jpg; 6 horizontal strips for the mission table, 2 for Y.M.C.A./Y.W.C.A.
Rows: Missions part 16 as printed (15 missions plus Total); Y.M.C.A. part 3. The table's title 'Protestant Mission Statistics, 1919' is printed at the top of p. 513; no table number.

Column heads: the spanning heads are FOREIGN WORKERS, NATIVE WORKERS, PLACES OF WORSHIP, MEMBERSHIP / ATTENDANCE (with 'Additions' over the three membership columns); sub-heads Evangelistic, Educational, Medical, Literary, Total (foreign) and Evangelistic, Educational, Medical, Colporteurs, Total (native), each with M. and W. The two printed 'Members' columns are labelled identically in the original (first presumably men, second women, not stated).
Printed dashes are written '—'. Mission names that wrap over lines are joined; names as printed except dot leaders removed.
Footnote marker 1 is printed after the last (Sunday School) dash of the British and Foreign Bible Society row; the printed footnote reads 'One worker included in London Mission report'.

Superscript markers (a small bold 2 and a 3) follow 2270 (Methodist Episcopal, Sunday School) and 600 (American Presbyterian, North, Sunday School); no footnote text for them is printed on p. 513 or 514. Cells are given as the figures only.
Cells in the 'United Methodist (Eng.)' row are printed on two lines (the native Educational M. 1 and Total M. 1 on an upper line); read by column alignment.
S. P. G. row: 'No report' is printed across the Places-of-Worship S.S. / Members columns; written in the first Members cell, and the S.S. cell is left empty.

Column-sum checks (rows vs printed Total): all agree except Foreign Total W. (rows sum 103 as read, printed 113; the printed Evangelistic/Educational/Medical/Literary W. totals sum to 98), Native Educational W. (rows sum 47, printed 48; Salvation Army row also shows Native Total W. 3 against components 1+1), and Church attendance (rows sum 4,368, printed total '—'). Several row totals as printed also differ from their parts (American Board Foreign Total W. 18 vs 1+10+1+1 = 13; Salvation Army Native Total M. 8 vs 7+2 = 9). All kept as printed.
American Board Foreign Total W. '18' read at high zoom as 18; the 3-vs-8 exception was not applied because no printed total settles it.
Y.M.C.A./Y.W.C.A. part: Foreign W. 6+4=10, Native M. 24, Native W. 3, Christian 250+119=369, Non-Christian 2,250+302=2,552, Total 2,500+421=2,921; all reconcile.
Verified: an independent blind second transcription agreed on every cell; the totals that do not reconcile are as printed.

table.title: Chinese Independent Churches, 1919
table.caption_extra: Printed rotated on the fold-out p. 514, below the Y.M.C.A./Y.W.C.A. table. The file is numbered p0547_2 because the fold-out begins on image p0547.
table.context: Following the Protestant mission statistics, this table gives 1919 figures for the three Chinese independent churches of Peking (N. E., South and East City), covering membership, attendance, paid and voluntary workers, schools and annual expenses.
transcriber_notes: Read from full-resolution crops of full/p0548.jpg rotated 90 degrees. Rows: 3 as printed plus Total.
Footnote marker 1 is printed after each Annual Expenses figure of the three locations ($240, 1,492, 1,154); the Total $2,886 has none. The dollar sign is printed on the first row and the total only.
Chapels cell for N. E. City is printed as a dash with a vertical stroke beside it; read as a dash.

Column sums: Churches 3, Chapels 1, Sunday Schools 4, Members 783, Probationers 120, New Members 51, Church 290, Sunday School 120, Evangelistic M. 5, Educational M. 7, W. 1, Voluntary 22, English 2, Primary 5, Boys 130, Girls 92 all reconcile; Annual Expenses 240+1,492+1,154 = 2,886 reconciles.
Column heads 'Attendance' spans Church and Sunday School; 'Workers Paid' spans Evangelistic and Educational (each M./W.); 'Schools' spans English and Primary; 'Students' spans Boys and Girls.

table.context: Listing the Protestant mission lower schools of Peking by mission and type (higher primary, lower primary, kindergartens, poor schools) with the number of schools and of men/boys and women/girls enrolled, ending with totals, in the Religious Work chapter.
transcriber_notes: Read from three full-resolution crops of full/p0549.jpg. Rows: 5+5+6+4+3+5 = 28 mission rows plus 3 total rows as printed.
Empty Men/Women cells are empty in the original (girls' schools have only Women figures, boys' only Men figures, except co-ed schools).
Printed totals as read: Total 68 / 1,971 / 1,465; Total Higher Schools 32 / 1,818 / 653; Grand Total 100 / 3,789 / 2,118. Checks (python): see below.

Checks (python3): the 28 listed rows sum to 68 schools, 1,971 men, 1,465 women = printed Total (reconciles; sections I 14/834/309 and II-IV 54/1,137/1,156). Total + Total Higher Schools: 68+32 = 100, 1,971+1,818 = 3,789, 1,465+653 = 2,118 = printed Grand Total (reconciles). The 'Total Higher Schools' line (32 / 1,818 / 653) is printed as a separate line and is not derived from the rows listed on this page.
